settings.heading:
The size your bed
was built for.
settings.lede: IKEA King is 160 by 200 centimetres. British King is 150. We make the first one, handmade to order, and tailor the feel after you have slept on it.

settings.heading: One hundred and sixty centimetres
settings.body:
Continental bed frames, IKEA included, take a mattress 160 centimetres wide. It is a standard across most of Europe and it is the size we build.

The British King is 150. Ten centimetres narrower, which sounds like nothing until it is a gap down one side of your bed and sheets that will not sit flat.

settings.heading: The exact size
settings.text: 160 by 200 centimetres, made to order. It fits the frame you already own.

settings.heading: Thirty five centimetres
settings.text: A pocket sprung core with a comfort layer above it, closed with a zip so the top can be renewed without the bed.

settings.heading: A feel you settle later
settings.text: Sleep on it for a month. Tell us how it should feel. We make it that way, with our compliments.

settings.label: Size
settings.text: 160 x 200cm. Fits IKEA and most continental frames.

settings.label: Core
settings.text: Pocket springs. Twenty five year guarantee.

settings.label: Comfort layer
settings.text: Removable and reversible. Two feels. You do not choose. It arrives with both.

settings.label: Bedding
settings.text: Takes standard European King linen, widely available online.

settings.heading: Specification
settings.promise_body: If the feel is not right, we will make you a new comfort layer to your preference, with our compliments. Worth [layer]. If that still does not settle it, we collect the mattress and refund you in full.

settings.heading: You do not choose the feel. You discover it.
settings.text: Sleep on it for a month. Tell us how it should feel. We make it that way.

settings.heading: It arrives finished.
settings.text: Concierged. Room of your choice. Unrolled onto your bed. The old one leaves with it.

settings.heading: It stays right for twenty five years.
settings.text: The part that softens renews. The part that lasts, lasts.

settings.heading:
A bed that becomes yours,
and stays that way.
Concierge unpacking
settings.text: Concierged. Room of your choice. Unboxed, unrolled, positioned. The packaging leaves with it. So does the old one.

settings.heading: Old mattress removal and recycling
settings.text: Taken away on the same visit. Nothing in the hall, nothing to arrange.

settings.heading: Nothing left behind
settings.text: Carton, plastic, wrap. All of it leaves with it.

settings.heading:
It arrives compressed.
We do not leave it that way.
settings.lede: Roll packing gets it up the stairs. It is not how it should be left.

settings.heading: Choose your size
settings.lede: Every size is handmade to order with the same 35cm construction and the same removable comfort layer.
